newsitem.title: USA: RMI Titanium, Galt sign investment pact.
newsitem.headline: RMI Titanium, Galt sign investment pact.

text.p: RMI Titanium Co said on Thursday it has completed its agreement to acquire 90 percent of Galt Alloys Inc after having received all regulatory approvals.
Galt is the largest U.S. manufacturer of ferrotitanium and a producer and worldwide distributor of specialty alloys to ferrous and nonferrous customers.
As a result of the agreement, Galt is undertaking an $18 million expansion program, RMI said in a statement.
The expansion will include a new scrap preparation facility, a plasma consolidation furnace and a plasma hearth furnace, RMI said.
